transcript: You drink water the wrong way my friend, and slowly it harms your body without you even knowing. Long ago my teacher, Dr. Li Zhongsheng, he lived to be 102, taught that even simple water mistakes can weaken digestion, slow your life energy and make you age before your time. Mistake number one, cold water. You think it feels good, but cold water shocks the stomach, tightens the blood and makes your body work too hard. Warm water keeps your inner fire strong. Mistake number two, drinking too fast. When you rush, your body cannot take in the water. Sip slowly, like feeding a small plant. Mistake number three, drinking while you eat. Water mixes with food and weakens the stomach's fire. Wait before or after meals and your body will thank you. Mistake number four, skipping water before bed. One small cup before sleep helps your body wash away the day's toxins. It gives you cleaner blood and calmer dreams. Mistake number five, wrong amount. Too little water dries the body. Too much burdens the kidneys. Find balance. Not too little, not too much. Remember, water gives life, but only when you drink it the right way. If you learned something new today, comment yes below, and follow me for more ancient health wisdom before it's forgotten.
